summary: The verifier runs the documented driver (its own copy) on sealed agreement files and compares every README key as an exact JSON integer, plus bill order. Each named RC-3 rule and each figure the manual leaves to today's code has an isolating fixture that a plausible wrong implementation fails. The sign partitions of miles and fuel and the grace boundaries are all covered. I recomputed the sampled expected values by hand and they match the manual. I found no false acceptance and no false rejection of contract-valid work.

files_read: tests/shipped/app/src/rentcharge/__init__.py (content established by manifest hash identity with environment/app/src/rentcharge/__init__.py)

checks_performed: Mapped each manual rule (1.2, 1.3, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5/3.3, 3.2, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3) and each README output key to the test and fixture rows that would fail if the rule were missing or reversed.

Grace boundaries in 01-grace: leftover 0 (G1), 1 (G2), 59 (G3), 60 (G4), 61 (G5), 1439 (G6), 20 min across a year end (G7), 59 min across a leap day (G8), exactly 1440 across a month end (G9). A >=59 implementation fails G3; a >60 implementation fails G4; the shipped ceil fails G2/G3/G7/G8.

Allowance interaction with charged days in 02-allowance: M4 (7d59m, 1051 mi, allowance 1050 gives charge 500; ceil-day allowance 1200 gives 0), M5 (7d60m, 1201 mi; a floor-day allowance gives 151), M8 (1d30m, 200 mi; ceil gives 0). The old 100-mile allowance fails M2/M3. Mile rate 0 is covered by M7.

Turnover sign partitions in 03-turnover: T1 999999->0 = 1, T2 = 400, T3 = 20000 across the wrap, T4 = 20000 with no wrap, T5 equal readings = 0. An abs() implementation fails T2, a modulus-999,999 implementation fails T1, and adding 1,000,000 on <= fails T5.

Fuel sign partitions: refuelling in 04-refuelling (F1-F4, including fuel_rate 0 with the fee alone and 8 eighths short at 2000), equal in 10-fuel_not_short (E1, rate 600, expects 0 so fee-on-equal fails), and fuller (E2/E3 expect negative, so a clamp to 0 fails). E4 is fuller at rate 0. Fill-to-full (8 - fuel_in) fails F4.
Tax base in 05-tax_base: X1 and X3 carry nonzero fuel, so taxing fuel fails. Fuller rows in 10/11 carry negative fuel, so taxing fuel changes the tax there too.

Tax rounding in 06-tax_rounding: R1 16.5->17 (truncation and banker's rounding both fail), R2/R3/R4 other exact halves, R5 99.99->100, R6 non-half. G1/G9/S1 are also exact halves. Rounding each component separately fails M8 (413+186=599 vs 598).

File totals and order in 07-order_and_totals: ids Z9, A-1, 0, MMMMMMMMMM are not in sorted order, so sorting fails. File tax is the sum of rounded taxes; taxing the file total instead fails 01-grace (8663 vs 8664). Revenue includes the negative total in E3.

Figures left to today's code: 08-short_days (S1 1 min, S2 30 min, S3 59 min, S4 60 min, S5 1439 min all expect days=1, so applying rule 2.3 to short rentals fails S1-S3) and 09-short_allowance (L1 101 mi expects 0, so a 100-mile or zero allowance for short rentals fails; L3/L4 exceed 150).
Hand recomputation of expected values: every row in families 01-11; generated rows 2W0, Z-7GD1, DO-PA4-113; limits rows AAAAAAAAAA, Z-9, B, L3, L7, L8, L17, L72, L78, L123. All agree with the manual.

Harness path: test.sh, then test_outputs.py import-time _install_driver/_seal_app, then bill_run runs 'python3 -I -S /app/tools/rentcharge_run.py <neutral agreements.json>' as UID 65534 through setpriv --no-new-privs. The driver's explicit sys.path insert of ../src makes -I/-S harmless, and the verifier's driver is byte-identical to the environment driver (same manifest hash).

Comparator: _same enforces type identity (bool and float rejected, as the README's integer promise requires). Extra keys are allowed and key order is irrelevant because output is parsed JSON. Bill count and order are compared.

Relabel path: a shift by whole weeks preserves minute lengths under naive datetime arithmetic, and the shift bounds keep every time inside 2000-2099. within_limits is re-asserted. Ids stay unique and match the rule 1.3 charset. Expected bills are permuted in the same order and revenue/tax are unchanged.

load() pins each fixture's SHA-256 and row count, checks rule 1.3, and confines short/fuller inputs to the families that grade them (SILENT). 13-limits holds 200 unique ids with every rate and reading end and 86,400-minute rentals, including one across the 2000 leap day.

test_submitted_driver_unchanged and the test.sh cmp enforce the instruction's byte-for-byte driver promise. test_candidate_cannot_read_verifier_state is environment-only and cannot falsely reject a valid candidate.

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to an assertion that fails if missing or reversed
coverage_sweep.reason: Every rule in manual sections 1-4 and both figures left to today's code have a dedicated test function and family whose fixture outcome changes when the rule is wrong (see checks_performed).

coverage_sweep.category: Check the full core result (values, membership, required outputs), not just existence
coverage_sweep.reason: compare() checks branch, revenue, tax, bill count, and all eight BILL_KEYS per bill, with exact type and value.

coverage_sweep.category: Each named domain rule has a case whose outcome changes when the rule is wrong
coverage_sweep.reason: Grace 59/60 (G3/G4), 150-mile allowance (M2/M3, L1), turnover (T1/T2/T5), refuelling fee (F3), fuel untaxed (X1), half-up rounding (R1, G9), file-order output (07), file tax as a sum of rounded taxes (01 file totals).

Statically traced against the fixtures, each of these fails at least one row: the unmodified shipped package, grace on short rentals, off-by-one grace, ceil- or floor-day allowance, a 100-mile allowance, abs or modulus-999,999 turnover, fee on equal or fuller fuel, a clamped negative fuel charge, fill-to-full shortage, taxing fuel, truncation, banker's rounding, per-component rounding, file-level tax rounding, and sorted output.

coverage_sweep.category: Contract-valid alternatives (formatting, ordering, implementation choices) are accepted
coverage_sweep.reason: Output is parsed as JSON, extra keys are ignored, and object key order and whitespace are irrelevant. Any stdlib implementation (Decimal, Fraction, integer arithmetic) is accepted. The isolated '-I -S' interpreter still finds the package through the driver's explicit sys.path insert. Only integer type and bill order are enforced, and the README and instruction both promise them.

coverage_sweep.category: Documented restrictions and lifecycle behavior enforced
coverage_sweep.reason: Leaving the driver unchanged byte for byte is enforced by test_submitted_driver_unchanged and by test.sh cmp. 'Add no clamp or guard' is enforced wherever it is observable within rule 1.3: negative fuel charges for fuller cars (E2/E3/C1/C2) and today's days for short rentals.

coverage_sweep.category: Signed derived quantities: legal sign partitions discriminated
coverage_sweep.reason: Odometer difference positive, zero and wrapped (T1-T5, Z-9). Fuel difference positive, zero and negative (F*, E1, E2-E4). Leftover minutes 0, 1-59, 60 and >60. Total negative (E3) and included in revenue.
Billing is a pure per-agreement computation plus file sums. There is no stateful event sequence.

coverage_sweep.category: Proxy rewards, stale binaries, self-controlled comparisons, unreachable cases
coverage_sweep.reason: Expected values are sealed, hash-pinned files independent of candidate output. The driver is the verifier's copy, installed before any candidate code runs. Every fixture is asserted to lie within rule 1.3, so no graded case is outside the contract domain. The relabel pass defeats branch- or id-keyed memorization.
Parsed JSON values are compared, not bytes. Stdout diagnostics are not graded, and stderr is ignored except in failure messages.

There is one test function per rule, and short/fuller inputs are confined to their own families (SILENT). Some rows cross rules (for example, grace rows also hit half-cent tax), which cannot change a binary reward.

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: M4 7d59m/1051 mi, M5 7d60m/1201 mi, M8 1d30m/200 mi: the allowance must use grace-charged days, not ceil or floor days.

rules: days left to today's code for short rentals
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: L1-L4: a short rental gets one day and a 150-mile allowance.
T2/T3 wrap and then exceed the allowance; L123 in limits wraps.

rules: fuel charge left to today's code (negative)
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: E2/E3/C1/C2: tax stays on time+mileage, the total includes the negative fuel charge, and revenue includes the negative total.
M8: combined 598.125 -> 598, whereas separate rounding gives 599. R1: 16.5 -> 17.
G9 exactly 1440 min and MMMMMMMMMM 1499 min give 1 day. A threshold misplaced above 1440 fails G7 (1460 min).
G7 year end, G8 leap day, AAAAAAAAAA and B at exactly 86,400 min, L17 from 2096-02-29, and relabel by whole weeks preserving lengths.
